verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs explicitly state interactive widgets let developers explore and test the Core API directly from the browser, plus a sandbox environment and simulation endpoints support runnable, hands-on exploration. However, there's no evidence of a full interactive API reference (e.g., try-it-console with live request/response, OpenAPI-spec-based explorer) and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, so the extent of interactivity is unclear. Missing for 10: confirmed OpenAPI/swagger-based reference, visible runnable code snippets per endpoint, independent corroboration of the widget experience.
